scope: Synthetic one-sphere wall command-line run, interrupted checkpoint, resumed run and VTK/CSV/JSON exports; software execution only

gates.first: Run with max-chunks=2 pauses at step 10
gates.resume: Resume completes at step 20 with checkpoint/4 and snapshot/3
gates.contact: Every diagnostic observation has positive wall-contact count
gates.work: Final wall work positive; cell work zero
gates.identity: Export labels translating-planes, orthogonal-wall-box and synthetic-dem
gates.snapshots: CLI export accepts new snapshots and writes VTK files
gates.sources: All frozen source, shader, input and synthetic-library hashes remain unchanged
